items.title: PayPal (PYPL) Joins Binance bStocks As Crypto Users Gain Stock Exposure
items.summary: Binance has added PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) to its bStocks tokenized stock lineup. The move lets Binance users gain price exposure and economic benefits linked to PayPal stock without directly owning shares. The addition expands access to PayPal for international investors who operate primarily through digital asset platforms.
